svg.title: Veronica AI Studio – Canvas Editor Layout
svg.desc: Wireframe layout of the canvas editor with toolbar, left icon rail, expandable side panel, canvas workspace, and right properties/AI chat panel. All measurements are in CSS pixels.
svg.text: CANVAS WORKSPACE flex-1 (~812px at 1440 viewport) bg=#191c22
Properties Panel OR AI Chat Panel (mutually exclusive)
OR: AIChatPanel (when AI Chat toggled on)
